game_concept: A logic puzzle set in Sand Dunes – Camel Trail, a camel trail: the oasis keeper must handle scarab swarms while practicing debugging & combined skills. Core idea – Validation Fortress: Write input checks that reject bad data so scarab swarms can't sneak through.
theme: Sand Dunes – Camel Trail: a camel trail
core_gameplay_loop: Construct a solution, execute it, inspect actual state and outputs, then revise until all mission goals pass.
player_objective: Week 3 examination practice: Algorithm synthesis: multiply every value by 5. Match all 3 streams; preserve their order. Dataset 9, operand 22.
controls: Edit both node programs. IN reads the upstream queue; OUT sends to the next node. Step advances one cycle; Run checks every stream.
win_condition: The executed solution satisfies every output and world-state check.
lose_condition: The available unsuccessful execution checks are exhausted.
assets_style: Shared Kenney CC0 tile and audio assets with deterministic Canvas layouts; assets are not duplicated per game.
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Validation Fortress' (Week 9 slot 14), mission type 'Efficiency Trial', and setting 'Camel Trail'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Sand Dunes
region.mood: desert oud, hand drums and sandy wind

tutorial: Read the objective, fixtures and command reference.
Build the circuit or route, or edit the node/adventure program.
Use Step to inspect state; Run checks the real outputs and goals.
Revise errors before using the remaining execution checks.
source_player_objective: Reach the caravan wagon using at most 11 actions, so every code step counts.
source_win_condition: The caravan wagon reached with actions_used <= 11.
source_lose_condition: actions_used exceeds 11 before the caravan wagon is reached, or lives reach 0.
hint: Follow the input through each operation. Compare every output, including negative inputs.
